description: This file is a C++ header (`.h`) defining the interface for the NetworkManagerClient class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It declares methods for managing network interfaces, Wi-Fi connections, and related operations in the context of a network management plugin, including Wi-Fi scanning, connection, WPS, and retrieving network device info. It includes external dependencies and appears to be intended for use by implementation files.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing network management functionalities such as interface listing, state control, IP configuration, Wi-Fi scanning, connection management, and WPS operations within the plugin namespace.

methods.name: NetworkManagerClient * getInstance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified network interface as primary.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for a specific interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Gets the current primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Gets the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the IP configuration of a specified interface.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Lists known Wi-Fi SSIDs.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves information about the connected Wi-Fi SSID.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a Wi-Fi SSID to the known list.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes a Wi-Fi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates a Wi-Fi scan, optionally for a specific SSID.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if Wi-Fi scan was performed within a specified recent interval.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info for a specified network interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a Wi-Fi network with given connection info.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a known Wi-Fi connection by interface and ID.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Gets the current Wi-Fi state.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Retrieves Wi-Fi signal quality and strength for an SSID.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Initiates WPS on Wi-Fi.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the device hostname.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies default network connection configurations.

methods.name: wpsProcess
methods.description: Handles the WPS process in a separate thread.

methods.name: getMatchingSSIDInfo
methods.description: Finds matching SSID info and access point path.

methods.name: isActiveApSameAsWps
methods.description: Checks if active AP matches WPS SSID.
